mcq.x: RBI Deputy Governor K.C. Chakrabarty resigned in 2014 before the end of his term; S.S. Mundra succeeded him.

mcq.s: Who became the first Indian woman to fly a fighter aircraft (MiG-21 Bison) solo, in February 2018?
mcq.x: Flying Officer Avani Chaturvedi flew a MiG-21 Bison solo from Jamnagar on 19 February 2018, the first Indian woman to fly a fighter aircraft alone.

mcq.s: On 30 June 2014 ISRO's PSLV-C23 launched satellites of other countries. Satellites of which of the following countries were NOT included?
mcq.x: PSLV-C23 carried SPOT-7 (France), AISAT (Germany), NLS 7.1 and 7.2 (Canada) and VELOX-1 (Singapore); no Austrian satellite was on board.

mcq.s: Which woman parliamentarian won the Lok Sabha election from the same constituency eight consecutive times?
mcq.x: Sumitra Mahajan won Indore (Madhya Pradesh) eight times in a row (1989-2014) and was Lok Sabha Speaker 2014-19.

mcq.s: Near which place was the epicentre of the earthquake that hit Nepal on 25 April 2015?
mcq.x: The magnitude 7.8 Gorkha earthquake of 25 April 2015 had its epicentre about 34 km east-southeast of Lamjung (near Barpak, Gorkha district).

1. Jayanti Patnaik
2. Mamta Sharma

mcq.x: Jayanti Patnaik was the first NCW chairperson (1992), followed later by Poornima Advani (2002), Girija Vyas (2005) and Mamta Sharma (2011).
